1. Each individual proposes to their highest-valued remaining good.
2. Each good rejects all but the highest-valued remaining individual who proposed to it.
3. If an individual is rejected by all goods, they are removed from the algorithm.
4. Steps 1-3 are repeated until all goods have been allocated.
